Happy Days Glasgow | face painting, glitter tattoos, balloon modelling, creative arts, bouncy castles & inflatables
Happy days will transform your guests into happy faces with high quality creative face painting.
Adding sparkle and fun for your guests using a range of stencils; superheroes, fairies, animals, dinosaurs and unicorns, and a range of colourful cosmetic grade glitters.

Happy days offers quick and simple balloon twisting designs; flowers, hearts, wands, pirate swords, hats, dogs, giraffes, butterfly wings and dinosaurs. Balloons are a fantastic playful addition to any party, keeping children entertained with something they can take home too!

Like the imagination there is no limit to the creative activities we can provide for your event. We can adapt to any theme and age group, supplying materials, setting up and cleaning to make crafting truly stress-free!
Our creative activities team is lead by principal artist Jo McMahon

Hi, I’m Jo, the company director at Happy Days Glasgow. I have always had a passion for the arts and people; I studied drawing and painting at Glasgow School of Art and later got a degree in Community Arts which has taken me all across the city working in a number of professional and community settings.
I love working with children and in recent years have lead community projects working with toddler groups, additional needs art sessions, after school art projects and children’s theatre.
Face painting and creative activities at events gives me a quick opportunity to connect and create a beautiful design and I love to see those happy faces in the mirror at the end.
We are able to cover areas in and around Glasgow and the West of Scotland. Please get in touch if you would like us to bring the sparkle, glitter and creative fun for your event.
